items.control_name: Enforce Private Service Connect (PSC) / Private Endpoints for Vertex AI
items.description: Vertex AI Workbench notebooks and training pipelines must not expose public IPs and must communicate over Private Service Connect.
items.current_value: All 6 Vertex AI Workbench instances deployed on Private Subnet with PSC
items.recommended_value: 100% Private Endpoints; 0 Public IPs on ML instances
items.remediation_notes: Ensure VPC Service Controls perimeter protects 'aiplatform.googleapis.com'.

items.control_name: Enforce Customer-Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK) on Vertex AI Datasets and Models
items.description: Training datasets, custom fine-tuned models, and inference caches must use Cloud KMS CMEK.
items.current_value: CMEK configured on production Vertex AI datasets; default Google encryption on experiment cache
items.recommended_value: CMEK enforced across 100% of ML datasets and model registries
items.remediation_notes: Configure Cloud KMS CryptoKey binding for Vertex AI service agent.

items.control_name: Enable Model Armor / LLM Guardrails against Prompt Injection & PII Leakage
items.description: Generative AI applications using Gemini/Vertex AI must implement Model Armor policies to filter prompt injection, jailbreaks, and PII output.
items.current_value: Model Armor policy 'prod-llm-guard' active with PII masking and prompt injection detection
items.recommended_value: Model Armor attached to all customer-facing LLM endpoints
items.remediation_notes: Regularly test adversarial prompts against AI safety filters.

items.control_name: Enforce Region Restriction on Vertex AI Data Processing & Training
items.description: All Vertex AI inference and model fine-tuning must execute within approved organizational regions (e.g., us-central1) to maintain data residency.
items.current_value: Region restricted to 'us-central1' via Organization Policy
items.recommended_value: Restrict processing to authorized data residency regions
items.remediation_notes: Audit audit logs for unauthorized multi-region ML API invocations.
